states: Private non-mock stack (backend on 7759, Vite on 5279 serving this adapter) with one real HTTP availability check polled every 10s against a local server switched between 503 and 200; resource deltas arrive over the live websocket in a visible headless Chromium page (Playwright 1.56.1).

Before the fix (origin/main adapter on the same stack): after the check recovered, REST returned available true with no consecutiveFailures/lastError, but the row kept FAILURES '32 in a row' beside a green '4 ms' result and Last healthy 'just now'; at 390px the row tooltip still read '2/2 failures - http probe returned status 503' and '2 failed checks in a row'.

With this content at 1440px and 390px: the same in-session 503 -> 200 transition shows FAILURES '—' and a fresh latency result, no stale 503/failure text in page text or title tooltips, and the expanded drawer's Availability card shows 'Up', the fresh latency and 1/1 reporting.
Summary-target switching and source withdrawal on a machine with attached checks are covered by adapter tests only (no agent-attached checks on this stack).
This is not a multi-location agent probe, certificate, installed-build or release acceptance.
interactions: Loaded /standalone/availability while the check was failing, flipped the local endpoint to 200 without reloading, waited for two successful poll ticks, then expanded the check row with a mouse click and inspected row text, title tooltips and the drawer.
Ran the pass at 1440x900 and 390x844 for both the unfixed adapter and this content; screenshots inspected for both widths.
